message: When I headed to the classroom in the morning, I heard lively voices.

name: Iori
message: 「That's... Ririmu's voice.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aaaahahahaha, are you serious！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Dead serious! Totally, completely serious!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Haaah, that's hilarious! Getting baited into coming to class with fried rice is seriously too funny.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I dunno, it feels like everyone treats me way too casually, or just half-asses it with me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wish they'd show me a little more respect...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, no way, not when it's you, Secchan.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What do you mean, 'no way'！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Still, I'm glad I got to hear about it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Compared to the Secchan capture op, mine was a hundred times better.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I think so too—taking all that time to rehearse a play and everything.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why did I just get 'You can have some fried rice' and call it a day!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, normally people don't get baited by fried rice, you know.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Are you actually a glutton, Secchan？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, I'm telling you, I was forced onto a low-carb diet right before that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「There was no rice, just tofu, okara, and chicken tenderloin over and over. I've had more than enough of bland meals like that...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ I stay on a low-carb diet all the time, though？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaat！？ No way！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm planning to do modeling in the future too, so I'm careful about keeping my figure.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh no... Are you an <d0052>ascetic monk</d>？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「An ascetic monk, really...? I don't think it's that rough.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ahem... You two, Iori-sensei is already here.」
Asahi cut in with a pointed reminder to the two engrossed in their chatter.

name: Iori
message: 「No, it's fine, Asahi.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm just glad to see you both having fun, Setsugekka, Ririmu.」
Before, Asahi was the only one in this silent classroom.
Today, lively conversation rings out from that very same room. Somehow, it made me happy.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei~, what are we doing today?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ooh, ooh! Help me out with my special training!」

name: Iori
message: 「No, sorry, I can't start the lessons just yet.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aww~, why not？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because our conquest operation isn't finished yet.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, you mean Kei-chan？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, Keisetsu already promised me she'll attend class as long as all the other students do.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Which means the last one left is Momicchi, huh?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Momicchi？ Oh, you mean Momiji-chan.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「When I asked her whether she liked Momijiru or Momicchi better, she picked Momicchi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh~, then maybe I'll try thinking up a nickname for her too!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Let's see... how about Momimomi？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha, that sounds kinda lewd.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「All right~! Then from today on, Momiji-chan is Momimomi!」

name: Iori
message: 「What's with that naming sense...？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I think it's a lovely nickname that truly reflects the intellect of the person who came up with it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're totally dissing me right now, aren't you？ Hey, I'm talking to you~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, next up is conquering Momiji.」

name: Iori
message: 「The difficulty of this operation is extremely high, yet failure is not an option. Everyone, brace yourselves！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, sir! When it comes to Momimomi, leave it to me!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san, you're staying behind to hold down the fort.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why？！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Because you screwed up your conquest mission, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「That is correct.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, right... I'll just stay behind and watch the house, then...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, hold on—Momimomi is my rival, you know？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The one to conquer Suzakuin Momiji is me！ That's a settled matter！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right, Muragaki-sensei?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, what's with that disgusted look?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I absolutely won't mess up this time, so please, I'm begging you!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Let me join the mission too！」

name: Asahi
message: 「What shall we do, Iori-sensei?」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm, it would be mean to leave her out, I suppose.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Iorin, you're such a softie~」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright then, everyone, let's begin the strategy meeting for the Momiji conquest mission！」

name: Setsugekka & Asahi & Ririmu
message: 「Okaaaay！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, how are we going to conquer Momimomi？」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, I'll leave it to you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Over the past few days, I have thoroughly investigated Momiji-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「As a result, I have obtained some astonishing information regarding her.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Astonishing information, you say？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Since this is highly classified, I will send it via a private channel.」
With a deft flick, Asahi gestured with her hand.
By now, a holographic display that only they could see must have appeared before Setsugekka and Ririmu.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh... w-what is this」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, is this really Momimomi？ Like, seriously！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way, no way, no way—this has to be a fake！ I mean, she's a Suzakuin, right！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I understand why you'd feel that way.」

name: Asahi
message: 「However, this is the truth.」
I was incredibly shocked myself when Asahi first showed me the footage.
To think Momiji had a secret like this.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Actually, the angle on this footage is really weird. Was this filmed secretly？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Doesn't really look like a selfie, huh?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't tell me, Muragaki-sensei, you snuck into Momimomi's room and...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I was the one who set it up.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I disguised myself as a cleaner and installed a few hidden cameras and bugs.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-isn't that a crime！？」

name: Iori
message: 「I asked Asahi to do it. So the responsibility lies with me.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I will stop at nothing to serve Iori-sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「To begin with, opposing you, Sensei, is the real crime.」
Ririmu is speechless. Well, I can understand how she feels.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But hey, if this video gets out, Momimomi is definitely going to be in trouble, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, she'd definitely want to keep it hidden at all costs.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then don't we not even need a plan anymore？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「We could just threaten her: attend class, or we leak this video. Done.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, Ririmu, that's a bad move.」

name: Iori
message: 「This footage is voyeuristic, meaning it's illegal data.」

name: Iori
message: 「If we go public with it, people will start asking 'who filmed this?', and we'd take a huge hit ourselves.」

name: Iori
message: 「Naturally, Momiji would exploit that fact.」

name: Iori
message: 「She'll push back, arguing that going public would be mutually destructive and gain us nothing.」

name: Iori
message: 「There's a high probability she'll lay out conditions and try to extract some kind of concession.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehh, aren't you overthinking it？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Momiji-san is a shrewd and cunning person. We cannot let our guard down.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So what do we do then？」

name: Iori
message: 「I was waiting for that question.」

name: Iori
message: 「If we can't release the video, then what's our move?」

name: Iori
message: 「The answer is... we catch her red-handed ourselves！」

name: Asahi
message: 「We barge right in while the exact same thing as in this video is happening.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That way, she won't be able to talk her way out of it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, that sounds super fun！ Let's do it, let's do it~！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nice, let's all corner Momicchi together~！」
Everyone getting all hyped up and noisy.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka aside, I didn't expect even Ririmu to be this into it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, I mean, she got me good too~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Besides, I wanna see the shocked look on Momicchi's face when she falls for a prank.」

name: Asahi
message: 「This is not a prank. Please do not lose sight of our objective.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, what was our objective again？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Why, to make Momiji-san submit completely to Iori-sensei, of course♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoaaa~！ I wanna make Momimomi submit too~！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, we're not making her submit, okay？ We're just getting her to attend class, alright？」
Or so I thought, harboring a faint tinge of unease.

name: Iori
message: 「Then let the final phase of Operation 'Green Grass Belongs to Everyone' commence！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, sir!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Roger that~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're still using that operation name...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm-hmm, hmm-hmm~ hm-hm-hmm~♪」
The great thing about Murakumo Academy is that every single student gets their own private dorm room.
Barring extraordinary circumstances, nobody else ever steps foot inside. In other words, it's a completely private sanctuary.

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaah, this is pure bliss, nya~」
My family home is a quintessential traditional Japanese house.
The partitions are just fusuma or shoji, with decorative transoms full of gaps above them. There aren't even locks on the fusuma, so anyone can waltz right in and out.
Privacy was practically nonexistent.

name: Momiji
message: 「That's no kind of environment for a maiden in the bloom of youth to live in...」
Today I scored a fine mackerel freshly landed at <d0053>Sakai Fresh Fish Market</d>.

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, whoever designed this dorm really knew what they were doing~」
Despite being a single dorm room, the generous kitchen leaves nothing to be desired when it comes to filleting fish.
I pull out my trusty fish knife and swiftly take off the mackerel's head.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hm-hm-hm~, hmm-hm-hm~... Oh, the flesh is so plump and springy~」
Split open the belly, pull out the innards, and give the bloodline a thorough rinse. Then I fillet it off the bone, peel away the skin, and remove the remaining bones.

name: Momiji
message: 「After all, a self-reliant swordswoman's gotta be handy with a kitchen knife too!」
Learning how to slice flesh while avoiding bone is experience no practitioner of the sword stands to lose from.

name: Momiji
message: 「Just kidding—I really just want some tasty snacks to go with my drink~」
Half lightly blanched, the other half as plain sashimi. It's a luxury made possible only by mackerel this outrageously fresh.

name: Momiji
message: 「Add the condiments and chopped shiso... and all done!」
A generous platter of mackerel sashimi is complete.

name: Momiji
message: 「Now to warm up the yakitori~ and get my little smoked squid ready too~」

name: Momiji
message: 「All done~!」
A spread of vibrant dishes lines up across my single-person table.

name: Momiji
message: 「All right, now for the star of the show!」
I pull an ice-cold 350ml can out of the fridge.

name: Momiji
message: 「This is it! You just can't get started without this~」
I nuzzle my cheek against that precious, beloved drink, emblazoned with the emblem of a blazing crimson phoenix.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well then, cheers to a party of one~!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mm... gulp...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Pwaaaahhhh, <d0054>Suzaku Hyper Dry</d>！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Aaah~, it soaks right into my soul~~~！」
The bitterness of fermented malt, the sharp bite of carbonation, and a crisp, ice-cold finish going down.

name: Momiji
message: 「To put it mildly, this is peak perfection！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Though I say that, it's actually non-alcoholic beer~」
Among all the non-alcoholic beers out there, my top pick is Suzaku Hyper Dry.

name: Momiji
message: 「Zero calories, zero purines, zero alcohol—totally free！ Recommended for active swordsmen too」
When I was a child, I accompanied my father to a gathering of the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association, and I was made to drink beer there.
At first I thought it was just bitter, but after drinking it a few times, I ended up finding it delicious.
That said, an academy student indulging in alcohol is completely out of the question. That's why I started drinking non-alcoholic beer.

name: Momiji
message: 「Heh heh heh, this is just carbonated barley tea, you know」

name: Momiji
message: 「Not a single problem at all~！」
Even so, public opinion is harsh.
Even though it's just a soft drink made to taste like beer, if an academy student like me drinks it, people give me disapproving looks.

name: Momiji
message: 「Seriously, what a ridiculous trend~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Encouraging underage drinking？ As if」

name: Momiji
message: 「Minors aren't going to drink bitter fizzy juice that can't even get them drunk」
This is something only adults who know how good beer tastes can enjoy.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, it doesn't matter as long as I'm drinking alone like this anyway」
A bite of the mackerel sashimi I just made, dipped in soy sauce mixed with condiments.
While the distinct fishy tang of blue-backed fish still lingers in my mouth, I wash it down in one gulp of beer.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ngh~~~, that's the stuff, that's it」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaah, pure bliss~」
The finest snack with the finest beer—it was a moment of pure bliss.

name: Momiji
message: 「That was a bit of a close call this time~」
There's a liquor store on the mainland where I'm a regular.
I always buy my non-alcoholic beer there, but on my way back I ran into Iori-sensei.
I had noticed Iori-sensei and Tobe Ririmu talking with the police in front of the station.
I tried to slip away without being seen, but Tobe Ririmu suddenly dashed straight toward me, so I missed my chance to escape.

name: Momiji
message: 「They were eyeing what was inside, so I thought they had some solid proof, but I guess not」
The way he panicked when I showed him the underwear I'd stashed in my bag as insurance was priceless.

name: Momiji
message: 「Pfft... He's surprisingly innocent, that teacher.」
A big bite of yakitori—chicken skin warmed up in the oven.
The crisp bite and the rich fat oozing out from inside—it's a wonderful combination.
I gently follow it up with a sip of beer, savoring the harmonious blend of flavors.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahhh, so good... When it comes to yakitori, it really has to be chicken skin and gizzards!」
Rare cuts are nice too, but if you're enjoying it on skewers, these two are the classics.

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaah... I can feel the stress just melting away...」
Living day in and day out as a Suzakuin is unbelievably stressful.
Of course, being a Suzakuin certainly comes with its perks. I'll admit that much.
Still, if I could be reborn, I wouldn't choose the Suzakuin Family.

name: Momiji
message: 「Being the eldest sister on top of it all... is just exhausting.」
There were times I thought about just running away from it all.
But if I run away, then my three younger sisters will be the ones sacrificed to duty.

name: Momiji
message: 「Nadeshiko, Miyako, and Tsubaki—they're all just too cute.」
I'd rather not put them through anything painful if I can help it.
In the future, one of us four sisters will most likely inherit the headship of the Suzakuin Family.
Inheriting the Suzakuin Family means leading the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association.
If things go as expected, that role will fall to me, the eldest sister.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, what a pain... I definitely don't wanna do it...」

name: Momiji
message: 「If someone else offered to do it instead, I'd hand it over in a heartbeat.」
The best-case scenario would be for Nadeshiko, Miyako, or Tsubaki to step up and say she wants to be the family head. Then I'd finally be free from all these obligations.

name: Momiji
message: 「Nadeshiko... Ahaha, yeah, no way.」
Nadeshiko, the second daughter, is friendly and popular in her class. She's strong at Jindou too, and she's already saying she wants to become a pro Jindou athlete in the future.
It's just a real shame, though... Nadeshiko isn't very bright.

name: Momiji
message: 「I think she's cut out to be an athlete, sure, but politics is a bit much for her...」
All sorts of riffraff with ulterior motives flock to the Suzakuin head.

name: Momiji
message: 「She's totally the type to get conned by some bad crowd in the future.」

name: Momiji
message: 「As for Tsubaki... Nope, no good. She's way too cute—I don't want to make her do it!」
I want her to grow up straight and true. I don't want to taint her with petty adult entanglements.

name: Momiji
message: 「Out of the three of them, Miyako seems to have the best aptitude for it, though~」
Even among the four of us, she has a slightly different air about her.
She's had unusually high spiritual power since birth, and when we were little, she could see all sorts of things the rest of us couldn't.

name: Momiji
message: 「She's a bit detached from the world... but she's got a good head on her shoulders.」

name: Momiji
message: 「All right~ Then let's raise Miyako to be the head of the family！」

name: Momiji
message: 「And then maybe I'll retire to a hidden village, nya~♪」
Just as I was wondering where a good place to retire would be.
My sixth sense tells me.
That something unnatural is closing in on me—
Suddenly, the window at the back flew open.
What about the lock, who's behind this, what's their goal—I started to think, then cut it off immediately.
Right now, covering my tracks comes first.
Crushed the aluminum can in my hand and shot it into the trash bin. Luckily, it was almost empty.

name: Momiji
message: 「Lights out！！！」
I shout, but—no response.
Strange, it's normally supposed to turn off by voice command—
Right then, a figure suddenly leapt in through the window.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Fwa-hahahahahaha, come quietly now！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Make way for Definitely-Gonna-Beat-Suzakuin-Man！」
It was Kazamine Setsugekka.

name: Momiji
message: 「You—what are you here for...！」
Without even answering, she charges in and grapples me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aw yeah, Momiji-chan secured~！」
In the blink of an eye, I'm pinned down.

name: Momiji
message: （Crap, this girl... she knows martial arts...！）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehehe, even a Suzakuin's no big deal without Origami~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Take that, take that~ How's it feel, frustrated~？」

name: Momiji
message: 「You little...！」
Annoyed, I reach my hands into Setsugekka's sides.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Take that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, bwahahahaha, u-hyahyahyahya...！ W-wait, tickling is playing dirty！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You broke into my room illegally, so don't you dare talk to me about playing dirty!」
Seeing her off balance, I use a tomoe nage to toss her aside.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ow-ow-owww！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You... how dare you do that to me！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Smoke screen, activate!」
I trigger the smoke candle I’d prepared for a moment like this via voice command.
It’s a top-tier disaster prevention tool—harmless to humans and capable of deploying a smoke screen in an instant.
――Or so it should be.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Huh, a dud? No way！」
I just checked it the other day... why on earth！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Take that！」
Just as I’m trying to process this, Setsugekka pounces on me again.

name: Momiji
message: 「What... seriously, what even are you！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I told you, I’m the girl who’s absolutely going to take down the Suzakuin！」

name: Momiji
message: 「That doesn’t make any sense！」
Setsugekka grapples me skillfully; without my sword, I’m at a disadvantage. I suppose that’s the advantage of a martial arts expert.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehehe, quit squirming, won't you? I promise I won't hurt you！」

name: Momiji
message: 「C-could you please stop pinning me to the bed and saying things like that！？」
I struggle, but I can’t seem to shake her off.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hehe, just leave it to me. I’m going to make you feel good.」

name: Momiji
message: 「No thanks, I’m quite alright！」
As I was engaged in this rough-and-tumble struggle with Setsugekka—

name: Iori
message: 「What’s going on? Is everything alright！?」
...Iori-sensei burst into my room.
After he used his master key to storm into Momiji's room.

name: Iori
message: 「I heard the commotion and rushed in, but... I never imagined it would be something like this.」

name: Momiji
message: 「……How disingenuous.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori-sensei, you rigged something in my room, didn't you？」
She’s likely referring to the fact that the room’s management system didn't react to her voice, and that the smoke candle failed to deploy.
She's trying to change the subject, but I'm not falling for it.

name: Iori
message: 「Now, what are you talking about？」

name: Iori
message: 「More importantly, let's talk about this. I want an explanation.」
I place the aluminum can I found in the trash bin on the table.
Even though it’s crushed, it’s plain for anyone to see that it’s wrapped in beer packaging.

name: Momiji
message: 「Whatever it looks like, it is what it is.」

name: Iori
message: 「So, are you saying you were drinking alcohol in the dormitory？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That is non-alcoholic beer. It is not alcohol.」

name: Iori
message: 「Non-alcoholic or not, beer is still beer.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It is merely a soft drink.」
Ho, so she’s going to insist to the very end that it isn't alcohol.

name: Momiji
message: 「Besides, even if you are a teacher, you shouldn’t have the authority to barge into a private dorm room, should you？」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s fine. I have permission from the dorm manager.」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Permission? You're not even trying to hide it, are you.」
Momiji makes a face like she’s about to click her tongue.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, now that I look, Momimomi’s room is actually pretty messy~」
Now that she mentions it, laundry and trash are scattered all over the place.

name: Momiji
message: 「How I choose to live my life in my own private space is none of your business.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And Kazamine-san, how long do you intend on staying here？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on now, we’re classmates.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You’re an irrelevant person.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s so mean! Don't be so cold!」

name: Iori
message: 「Regardless, even if it’s non-alcoholic, I can’t approve of drinking beer in the dorms.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I told you, it’s not beer.」

name: Iori
message: 「So, you have nothing to hide？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I do not.」

name: Iori
message: 「Then it wouldn't be a problem if this were made public, would it？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s quite unbecoming for a teacher to act like a snitch, don’t you think?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Besides, I wasn't the one drinking that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, really? Then who was?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I just picked up some trash that was lying around.」

name: Iori
message: 「And what proof do you have that you picked it up as trash？」

name: Momiji
message: 「And what proof do you have that I was the one drinking it？」
Huh, she's actually going to pull that excuse at this stage.
As expected of Suzakuin Momiji, she's not one to be easily cornered.

name: Iori
message: 「Fine, if you’re going to be like that, I’ll produce the evidence.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, come on in.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Momitchi, lying isn’t good, you know~」

name: Asahi
message: 「We have concrete proof that you were drinking that soft drink.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Tobe-san, Kuki-san…？」
Ririmu and Asahi enter the room.

name: Momiji
message: 「What do you mean, you have proof？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please, look at this recording.」
Asahi shares a holographic video with Momiji.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Th-this is？！」
Momiji plays the video, and the audio of the decisive moment begins to fill the room.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well then, cheers to a party of one~!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mm... gulp...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Puuuhhh—, Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Aaah~, it soaks right into my soul~~~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Th-this is…！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, would you two stop repeating that！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Momichi, you really know how to down a drink, huh~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wonder if non-alcoholic beer is any good」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, don't even think about it」
I think she'll be fine, but I make sure to warn her just in case.

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, this is footage from a hidden camera, isn't it！？」
Judging the camera's location from the frame of the footage, I start rummaging through the trash bag.

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, it was so full of trash that hiding it was easy.」

name: Asahi
message: 「This is what happens when you don't keep your room properly cleaned up.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn't this voyeurism！? That's a straight-up crime！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, it is a crime.」
Asahi smiles brightly, not looking the least bit remorseful.

name: Asahi
message: 「However, I trust you now understand that your excuse of 'I just picked up the empty beer cans from the trash can' won't hold water.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh... grrr...」
Momiji gnashes her teeth.

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori-sensei, why didn't you stop Kuki-san？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Doing something like filming us in secret is definitely going to cause trouble later！」

name: Iori
message: 「It's not that I didn't stop her, it's that I'm the one who told her to do it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh！？ Are you serious！？」

name: Iori
message: 「I didn't really want to do it, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「But it didn't look like Momiji would be willing to accept my guidance unless I did something like this.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...I don't think you're in your right mind.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Just so you know, if this whole mess goes public, you're the one who will be in the most trouble, Iori-sensei.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'll just suffer a minor loss of credibility, but you'll definitely end up getting arrested by the police.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, you're right.」
If it turns into a police matter, a teacher who secretly films his students is a guaranteed lockup.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I suppose I have no choice.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Let’s just treat this as an act of overzealous concern on my part as a teacher.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It doesn’t seem like you had lewd intentions, so I’ll refrain from bringing this to the public eye myself.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Shall we call it even if you delete that footage?」
Momiji wore a composed smile.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Whoa, that’s amaaaazing.」

name: Momiji
message: 「What is？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, y'know, Iori-rin told me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「He said that since Momitchi’s smart, you’d see through it and try to offer a deal to make us back down, instead of reporting the candid filming.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You were dead on, so I’m honestly surprised.」
Exactly as expected; Momiji’s line of reasoning was exactly what we had anticipated.

name: Iori
message: 「What’s wrong？ Is there some reason why you can't have this footage remaining？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I simply thought it would be better deleted, as it constitutes evidence of a crime.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I was offering that advice out of concern for you both, but is there some sort of problem with that？」
Hmm, so she’s still not backing down.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, do you have no intention of attending the Takamura Class？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I do not.」

name: Iori
message: 「...Can't be helped. I didn't want to use this method if I could avoid it.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you’re going to insist on refusing, I’ll have to use my trump card.」
I never thought that just stepping in would be enough to make Momiji yield.
I needed a trump card to deliver the finishing blow.
I’d been wondering what to do, but my trump card was very close by.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Wh-what are you planning on doing？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yo, Momiji. Looks like you’re having some fun.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ngh... M-Mikoto-san！？」
The trump card in the battle against Momiji―it was none other than this Sasaki―sensei.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oh man, drinking stuff like this... Not being able to have the real thing must be rough」

name: Momiji
message: 「U-Um... why are you here？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hey, hey, did you forget？ For what it's worth, I'm the homeroom teacher for Takamura Class」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I leave the guidance to Muragaki, the assistant homeroom teacher, but I worry about my students just the same」

name: Momiji
message: 「'Worry'? Saying something so shameless again...！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「So？ Are you the one who drank this？」

name: Asahi
message: 「We have video footage, Sasaki-sensei」
In place of the silent Momiji, Asahi shows Sasaki-sensei the footage from earlier.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well then, cheers to a party of one~!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mm... gulp...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Puuuhhh—, Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Aaah~, it soaks right into my soul~~~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Stop replaying it over and over！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oh ho, you really know how to knock it back」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You're gonna grow up to be a real heavy drinker. Let's grab a drink together when you do」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That said, for an academy student, this is a bit of a provocative sight, wouldn't you say」

name: Momiji
message: 「B-But Mikoto-san, that's secret filming, a criminal offense...！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah, of course I know that」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Including that part, I'm not quite sure how I should handle this on my own」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Maybe I should just go ahead and consult Masatane about...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Okay, I get it, Iiiiii geeeeeeet iiiiiiiit！！！」
Momiji roared, cutting off Sasaki-sensei's words.

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes, you're right, it's my loss! I give up, I surrender!!」

name: Momiji
message: 「I knew it！ The moment Mikoto-san showed up, I knew for a fact you'd play that card at the end！」

name: Momiji
message: 「This is so unfair~~~！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, Momimomi snapped」

name: Momiji
message: 「Of course I did, this is practically dragging a parent into a kids' fight」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, geez, I hate you, Iori-sensei！」
Momiji begins to writhe and kick on the floor like a spoiled child.
I see, so this is Momiji's true colors.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahahaha, Momimomi is wriggling on the ground~」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Setsugekka was doing that just the other day too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, I was not.」

name: Iori
message: 「You were thrashing around remembering that thing you did in front of the convenience store, weren't you?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaaaaaaa！ Don't make me remember that~~！！」
Setsugekka rolls around on the ground next to Momiji.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...What is it.」

name: Iori
message: 「You'll be attending class starting tomorrow, right, Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I'll go.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're just going to show that footage to my father if I don't, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don't really have a choice but to go now, do I.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I have no idea what he'd make me do if he saw that.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm glad to see you've had a change of heart.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei... you're definitely not going to have a peaceful death, you know？」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll be sure to be as careful as I can.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmph, idiot, idiot.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, Sensei, is the conquest operation over now？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, operation complete.」
The Momiji conquest operation, which had been expected to be a fierce battle.
However, thanks to Sasaki's intervention, Momiji had fallen without much of a fight.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well done, Muragaki.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「But don't get careless. These ones aren't baby birds.」

name: Iori
message: 「Fully grown birds of prey, are they？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That is how it is. You may call for me whenever you need me」

name: Mikoto
message: 「If you're having trouble handling Momiji, I'll lend a hand anytime」

name: Iori
message: 「You heard her, Momiji」

name: Momiji
message: 「A hot-blooded teacher and Mikoto-san... what a nightmare combination, seriously...」
Drooping her shoulders in disappointment.

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, with this, all the students of the Takamura Class should be present starting tomorrow」

name: Iori
message: 「That way, I'll be able to give everyone equal instruction」

name: Iori
message: 「Thanks, everyone！ I look forward to working with you all starting tomorrow！」
